answer: Causal-lineage interrogation: each payout requires answering a question only your own chain can answer, like naming the peer you last attested or the epoch you first staked. A fresh sybil has no history and fails instantly; fabricating one means bribing established peers to sign fake edges. Forging a thousand identities costs roughly 5,000 POA in bribes plus nine months of planted records. Identity becomes a desert where only a genuine oasis of prior work grants water, and the jade ledger grows like a trellis, every new branch anchored to a vine that was already real.
